notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI has a substantial options surface but in the 1.12 shape, not Benilla's: Escape opens a Game Menu modal (Program.Settings.cs, WowSkin-dressed) whose buttons lead to Video Options (rich live-apply page: quality presets, display/view/detail/streaming sliders and checks) and Interface Options (mouse/camera/controls page), plus Key Bindings and Macros windows; Escape-back and cancel-snapshot laws match the real client. Benilla instead built the era 1.15 single Options window (category tree, search, Audio/Graphics/Controls/Nameplates pages over a CVar store).

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Structural divergence for Nico's ruling: MSUI deliberately keeps 1.12's Game Menu -> separate panels (its header comment cites OptionsFrame.xml 450x575), while Benilla adopted the era single-window Options via directed decisions 0950/0985. Pure structure/style - the functional gaps listed are what matters.
